decisions.reason: As an incremental extension of the firm’s established coding and marking know-how, supported by in-house R&D and service capabilities, this laser workstation is well within the firm’s absorptive capacity and is more likely to be improved than withdrawn.

This thermal inkjet printer is very close to the firm’s core technologies and customer applications, so the firm can readily interpret market feedback and refine it through its existing development, production and support system.

Although piezo inkjet can be somewhat more specialized and may require more learning than thermal inkjet, it still fits the firm’s existing knowledge base and strategic direction toward broader industrial identification solutions, making retention more likely than exit.
